query: What steps must a provider follow to place a high-risk AI system on the EU market?
answer: A provider must: (1) implement a quality management system, (2) prepare technical documentation, (3) conduct a conformity assessment (self-assessment or via notified body depending on the category), (4) register the system in the EU database, (5) affix the CE marking, (6) issue an EU declaration of conformity, and (7) establish post-market monitoring.
